meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: Claude 会把 Discord 适配器复制进项目、注册并安装依赖，跑构建和注册测试；然后引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，自动推导并保存凭据、重启服务、开通私聊频道。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人频道时触发，通常是在 /setup、/init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 流程里添加 Discord 渠道。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 我的 Discord Bot Token 是：<粘贴 Token>
say.note: 校验后自动推导并保存凭据

say.text: 把 Discord 频道接好并重启服务
say.note: 重启服务加载适配器与凭据

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Discord adapter, registers it, and installs the @chat-adapter/discord package, then builds and runs the registration test. It guides bot creation, takes your Bot Token, stores credentials, and resolves your DM channel.
howto.when_en: When you want NanoClaw to use a Discord bot channel — typically during setup or when adding a channel via /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Discord channel support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, runs the test

say_en.text: My Discord Bot Token is: <paste token>
say_en.note: Validates it and stores derived credentials

say_en.text: Wire up the Discord channel and restart the service
say_en.note: Restarts to load the adapter and credentials
